capability_statement: AOF can replay an external validation result against provider-read evidence and show whether confidence increased, decreased, stayed unchanged, or must be escalated.
before_state: External validation results could be mentioned in release notes, but AOF did not audit how the result changed provider-read confidence.
after_state: AOF records validation result, confidence before/after, replay steps, governance route, no-write boundary, and not-proven limits in one audit chain.
scenario: A reviewer says the v11.2 GitHub read is only partially validated; inspect the replay record and audit to see how AOF treats that result without overclaiming it.
five_minute_demo: Open TASK-134-external-validation-replay.json and external-validation-replay-audit.json; confirm validation result, confidence delta, governance route, and zero write authority.
time_saved_or_work_reduced: Removes manual argument about whether a validation result supports, blocks, or weakens the provider-read claim.
cognitive_load_removed: The operator no longer has to infer whether partial or conflicting validation was hidden; the route is explicit.

capability_matrix.before: validation result was prose-only or release-note-only evidence
capability_matrix.after: validation result is replayed into confidence and governance routing
capability_matrix.user_value: operator can see what changed in confidence and whether uncertainty was escalated

not_proven: This does not prove provider semantic truth, actual independent third-party validation, GitHub write safety, credential safety, production automation, market value, productivity gain, or broad adoption.
